text:
sam (SRE): :warning: Alert: sustained surge in reserved-capacity usage in eu-west-2 — admission controller firing continuous throttles, several dedicated customers reporting errors.
jen (Infra): I'm seeing pool 'resv-eu-west-2-02' at 98% alloc, queue depth growing, token reclaim not catching garbage.
mike (Prod-Eng): Any recent rollout to the scheduler?
ops-bot: [ALERT] reserved_pool_high_utilization pool=resv-eu-west-2-02 pct=98 window=15m
jen (Infra): No scheduler rollout in last 24h. There was a scheduled nightly burst job for analytics that should cap at 10 concurrent, but it's spawning hundreds — suspect a cron misconfig.
sam (SRE): Can someone tail pool-manager logs and grep for lease reacquire errors?
jen (Infra): running: ``kubectl -n infra logs deploy/pool-manager | grep -i lease`` -> seeing a repeated "failed to release lease: timeout" every 3s from the same pod.
mike (Prod-Eng): Looks like the analytics job is leaking leases. Which tenant? Trace id 0x7f3a in logs points to tenant_id=acct-7782-batch.
ava (Support): Support is getting pings from dedicated customers with 429s and failed requests. One customer asked for ETA on mitigation.
sam (SRE): Immediate mitigation steps: 1) pause scheduled analytics bursts 2) bump soft admission limit for enterprise tier only (so best-effort tenants still get evicted) 3) recycle pool-manager pod to force lease reclaims.
jen (Infra): Pausing cron job now: ``kubectl -n jobs patch cronjob analytics-burst -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`` -> applied.
jen (Infra): Increasing soft limit for enterprise via api: ``curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control-plane/api/pools/resv-eu-west-2-02/adjust -d '{"soft_pct":90,"priority_overrides":[{"tier":"enterprise","pct":95}]}'`` -> 202 accepted.
sam (SRE): Recycling pool-manager: ``kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/pool-manager``. Monitoring.
ops-bot: [ACTION] Incident owner assigned: sam (SRE).
jen (Infra): After restart: leases showing as freed, alloc down to 65%, queue depth decreasing. Throttle events still spiking but much reduced.
mike (Prod-Eng): We'll push a quick fix to the analytics job to enforce concurrency and add exponential backoff, PR coming.
ava (Support): Messaging drafted for affected customers — letting them know we've mitigated and will follow up with root cause and compensation if needed.
sam (SRE): Next steps: root cause postmortem, add a guard in admission controller to detect lease-release stalls and trigger soft-evictions earlier, add alert for scheduled-jobs spawning beyond threshold.
jen (Infra): Adding temporary rate-limit override to avoid cross-tenant bleed while we finish fixes. ``curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/rl/override -d '{"pool":"resv-eu-west-2-02","policy":"isolate", "ttl":600}'`` -> applied.
mike (Prod-Eng): Re: cost implications — these burst jobs ran longer than expected; we'll estimate extra GPU hours and include in postmortem.
sam (SRE): Thanks team. If alerts fully quiet by +30m we'll start RCA. Ava, please escalate to account ops for any enterprise SLA touches.
ava (Support): On it. Notifying 3 impacted accounts now.
jen (Infra): Final alloc 28%, queue drained, throttles back to baseline. Closing immediate fire. Will file incident ticket for detailed follow-up.
sam (SRE): Closing thread for now — will reopen if anything reappears. :white_check_mark:
